episodes.title: Travelers
episodes.summary: Five strangers become an elite team of secret operatives when time travelers take over their conscious minds.

episodes.title: Protocol 6
episodes.summary: The team's first mission goes awry when a fatal mistake leaves them holding a ticking time bomb.

episodes.title: Aleksander
episodes.summary: A team member buckles under the guilt of not being allowed to prevent future deaths and puts the travelers in jeopardy.

episodes.title: Hall
episodes.summary: MacLaren's leadership is challenged when he's directed to assist a more experienced team of travelers that wants to join forces.

episodes.title: Room 101
episodes.summary: MacLaren is on his own as he fights to unravel the mystery of his team's sudden disappearance.

episodes.title: Helios-685
episodes.summary: Team tackles their primary mission: to stop a cataclysmic event that will change the course of human history.

episodes.title: Protocol 5
episodes.summary: The team struggles to live 21st century lives as they're faced with the prospect that their missions might be over for good.

episodes.title: Donner
episodes.summary: MacLaren has to find a lone bomber who kills a newly arrived group of travelers.

episodes.title: Bishop
episodes.summary: The Director orders an assassination and MacLaren is kept on a tight leash.

episodes.title: Kathryn
episodes.summary: On the brink of death, MacLaren slips in and out of his host's memories.

episodes.title: Marcy
episodes.summary: Trevor defies the Director while the team contends with Marcy's inevitable death.

episodes.title: Grace
episodes.summary: An assassin traveler arrives in the present, exposing the truth about a disturbing schism between warring factions that is unfolding in the future.

episodes.title: Ave Machina
episodes.summary: Grant MacLaren and his team find themselves in FBI custody with no means of escape, while a mysterious new traveler reveals secrets to his psychiatrist.

episodes.title: Protocol 4
episodes.summary: Philip makes an unexpected connection, Marcy helps David cope with his trauma, and MacLaren discovers a shocking truth that Kathryn has been hiding from him.

episodes.title: Jacob
episodes.summary: After tracking down a missing traveler, the team is led to some disturbing answers about their kidnapping.
MacLaren and the team must help a fellow traveler plan his own assassination, while helping an unsuspecting activist complete a deadly mission.

episodes.title: Jenny
episodes.summary: A deadly disease is spreading around the world, and the travelers must get to the bottom of where it came from and how to stop it, before it's too late.

episodes.title: U235
episodes.summary: With the unknown virus rapidly spreading, the team is left with only one option in order to save The Director hundreds of years in the future.

episodes.title: 17 Minutes
episodes.summary: A skydiving traveler must try, repeatedly, to save our team from a horrible fate.

episodes.title: Traveler 0027
episodes.summary: After receiving an unusual message to attend a court proceeding, the travelers find that one of their own is on trial for conspiring against The Director and interrupting the Grand Plan.

episodes.title: Update
episodes.summary: Philip's timeline receives an update with some unwanted side effects, Trevor makes a disturbing discovery about his host's past, and MacLaren deals with the return of a traveler he thought had gone away for good.

episodes.title: 21C
episodes.summary: While MacLaren, Carly, Trevor, and Philip work with another traveler team to protect a child important to the future, Marcy takes measures to remember her past life – but uncovers more than she bargained for.

episodes.title: Simon
episodes.summary: When the team meets Simon, a homeless man with a startling history, they're led down a path that leads directly to the very first traveler.
In the season finale, the travelers must follow the rules of a madman in order to rescue their kidnapped loved ones and ensure the traveler program isn't exposed to the world.

episodes.title: Ilsa
episodes.summary: MacLaren, his team and their loved ones regroup at a safe house protected by the FBI, but doubts and betrayals may sabotage the rest of their mission.

episodes.title: Yates
episodes.summary: MacLaren and Yates adjust to their new partnership while protecting a TV show host whose inflammatory rhetoric about Travelers has led to tragedy.

episodes.title: Protocol 3
episodes.summary: Certain that his team erased his memory of the previous day, MacLaren retraces his steps in the case of a disturbed youth with a horrific future.

episodes.title: Perrow
episodes.summary: The team learns that Traveler 001 is still alive when the Faction tries to capture him. Doubts about their loved ones worsen for Kat, Jeff and David.

episodes.title: Naomi
episodes.summary: The team attempts to extract a rogue A.I. from a child messenger, but the program expands too rapidly. A new Traveler adjusts to his host.

episodes.title: Philip
episodes.summary: The Faction kidnaps Philip and a group of other historians, forcing MacLaren and the team to extract their location from a critically injured Hall.

episodes.title: Trevor
episodes.summary: Suffering from a fatal brain disorder, Trevor makes the choice to allow himself to be overwritten as the team races to invent an experimental cure.

episodes.title: Archive
episodes.summary: MacLaren urges Yates to help him when a Traveler with a mission vital to humanity's survival arrives in the body of a just-captured serial killer.

episodes.title: David
episodes.summary: The Faction sets off nuclear blasts that destroy all of the Travelers' archives, except the one in which a wounded David just happens to be trapped.

episodes.title: Protocol Omega
episodes.summary: Shattered by recent losses and a sweeping new protocol, the Travelers face a bleak future with only one long-shot chance to succeed in their mission.
